description:
Implement a cache-blocked, delayed-reduction FieldMatrix multiplication path for prime fields where fflas-ffpack is currently orders of magnitude faster.

## Background

`64c88ae4` shows small-prime GF(p) fgemm is about 0.00-0.03x of fflas-ffpack because gf2-core performs modular reduction too frequently and lacks a BLAS-like blocked accumulation strategy. This task targets the algorithmic arithmetic layer: accumulate products into wider integer lanes where sound, defer modular reduction by a proven safe bound, and block for cache reuse.

## Amendment Note

The aspirational n>=256 fflas-ffpack comparison is deferred to the existing slow/nightly `fieldmatrix_gemm` reference sweep. This implementation records fast development cells in `dev/benchmarks/e7ab802d-fieldmatrix-gemm-delayed.md`: 64x64x64 `Fp<7>`, `Fp<251>`, and `Fp<65521>` compare eager per-MAC reduction against the production delayed-blocked path and show about 2.28x-2.34x speedup. The n>=256 fflas-comparable target remains a follow-up measurement item rather than a closure blocker for this task.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] FieldMatrix multiplication for at least the benchmarked small/medium prime fields gains a delayed-reduction/cache-blocked path with mathematically justified accumulator bounds documented in code or a linked design note.
- [hard] Correctness is covered against the existing scalar path for the benchmarked primes, including rank/shape edge cases used by `64c88ae4` where applicable.
- [hard] Benchmarks compare pre/post throughput for the `64c88ae4` fgemm cells that can run in the fast development budget, and document any cells deferred to slow/nightly benchmarking.
- [hard] The implementation does not weaken finite-field invariants or introduce broad casts/unchecked arithmetic without explicit bound proofs.
- [hard] `cargo-ci` and `code-review` gates pass.
- [aspirational] Fast-budget 64x64x64 GF(p) cells demonstrate a clear speedup for the delayed-blocked production path; full n>=256 fflas-ffpack comparison remains deferred to slow/nightly benchmarking.
title: Add delayed-reduction blocked FieldMatrix multiply for GF(p)
